title: Filtered Hom continuity for a locally finite free internal module
statement: Let X have noetherian underlying space, Λ be a commutative condensed ring, and P an internal Λ_X-module which becomes finite free on a pro-etale covering. For any (u+1)-small filtered diagram N of cochain complexes with a common termwise lower bound and any integer n, the canonical map colim Hom(P[0],QN_i[n]) → Hom(P[0],Q(colim N)[n]) is an isomorphism of abelian groups.

proof.text: Termwise H preserves zero objects and therefore the common lower bound. Apply qcqs derived global sections continuity to N followed by termwise H. At the common termwise lower bound the good truncation projection is an actual isomorphism of complexes, so its cocone is a colimit cocone. Transport the resulting colimit along its unique isomorphism to the canonical cocone.

lean.statement:
theorem condensed_finite_free_hom_continuity
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace X]
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ]
    (P : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X))
    (hP : ∃ C : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage X, ∀ s : C.I₀,
      Mod.IsFree ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (C.f s)).obj (condensedRingObj Λ X))
        (((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} (C.f s)).mapMod (condensedRingObj Λ X)).obj P))
    {I : Type (u + 1)} [SmallCategory I] [IsFiltered I]
    (N : I ⥤ CochainComplex
      (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
        (condensedRingObj Λ X)) ℤ)
    (hN : ∃ a : ℤ, ∀ (i : I) (r : ℤ), r < a → IsZero ((N.obj i).X r))
    (n : ℤ) :
    IsIso (colimit.desc _
      ((condensedShiftedHom Λ X
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj P) n).mapCocone (colimit.cocone N)))
